propositions: event_append.py exceeds 791 LOC and approaches the 800-LOC hard module-size cap, creating refactoring urgency
git subprocess primitives and constants should be extracted into a new leaf module event_append_git.py to reduce parent module LOC and create a single home for git-subprocess changes

event_append.py must retain API, validation, recovery routines, and monkeypatch seams to avoid breaking test coupling between stage_and_commit and _recover_from_invalid_object via shared _git_add references
public and private symbols must be re-exported from event_append.py to preserve all existing test/consumer access patterns (dotted, setattr/getattr) without test edits
event_append_git.py must be a leaf module with no circular or sibling dependencies, owning all subprocess and time imports required by git primitives
